title: Email: Fw: Collapse of the Tigers

content.text:
Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Philip Marcuse <pmarcuse@sbcglobal.net>
Sent: Tuesday, September 22, 2015 9:57 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Collapse of the Tigers 
 
The answer to the Tiger’s collapse is obvious. As far back as 2009, whenever Charley Marcuse, “The Singing Hot Dog Man,” was roaming Comerica Park, there was only one season, 2010, when the number of season losses was as high as 81. It’s not nearly the end of September and they already have 81 losses. So, clearly, it really was the short-sided firing of Charley last year that is to blame for this year’s troubles, not Brad Ausmus’ coaching. Just saying.
Philip Marcuse
